snippet.title: Vindictus: Defying Fate - Game Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Vindictus: Defying Fate is an action RPG set in a world inspired by Celtic mythology, where heroes stand against colossal foes.

"The gates of paradise shall open when one race eradicates the other."
Ruled by this prophecy, Humans and Fomors have soaked the continent of Taranúil in each other's blood for ages. Join the Kalbram Mercenaries as a new recruit, uncover the plot hidden beneath the conflict, and master combat where every parry, block, and sidestep opens the way to a killing blow.
Choose your heroes, craft your weapons, shape your look ─ and defy the fate that binds us.

* Subtitles available - click the Subtitles (CC) button


Official Homepage: https://vdf.nexon.com/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814860
